summary: A losing candidate concedes at the party with a joke, thanks groups by name, and says the work is not over.
realLife: At a hotel party a mayoral runner-up congratulated the winner, teased about local speech, thanked the unions and family who backed her, and told supporters the civic work continued.
inGame: race result read at the party; supporters' groups from the campaign record

turns.turn: She keeps it light and warm
She skips the fight of the last weeks and speaks only of thanks
turns.pulledBy: a wish to end on peace
turns.writesBack: a speech without the issues that split the race
